reason.description: Required for needs_input; optional for blocked; omit for completed. Explain the situation in summary. For needs_input, use sign_in, verification_code, captcha, payment, approval, missing_information, decision, user_action, or other, or personal_agent_protocol when you stop because the site supports the Personal Agent Protocol. Payment means missing payment details or a payment choice; approval means permission for something outside the assignment, not the separate purchase approval. Use user_action for a step only the user can take themselves, in this browser after taking it over or on their own device, such as a phone or app approval, a passkey or security key, a PIN or security question, or a window this browser holds for them. Use other only when no other label fits. Use captcha only for an unsolved puzzle when the user can take over this browser and no other site will do. For blocked, omit it when no label fits, or use bot_wall, captcha_unsolved, ai_agent_refused, ip_blocked, rate_limited, sign_in_required, sign_in_rejected, not_available, site_error, site_unreachable, approval_denied, browser_failure, or order_unconfirmed. Use order_unconfirmed when the merchant's outcome remains unresolved after permitted verification and no user input can resolve it.
